description: List the company's invitations that a `people:invite` key could have written (roles operator, editor, viewer, filer), each with email, role, teamIds, status (pending or accepted), invitedAt and acceptedAt. Requires an API key with the `people:invite` scope, held by an owner. Owner invitations are not listed.
name: anyforge_list_people_invitations
title: List people invitations
